person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third-person. Several Goodreads passages sustain external narration of Inman or Ada while entering their perceptions and beliefs, and both publisher/interior excerpts independently show the same technique. The novel alternates chiefly between Ada- and Inman-centered chapters, but scholarly and explicit whole-book sources establish that these are changes of focal character, not changes of grammatical person, so ALTERNATING does not apply. Apparent first-person counterexamples q00233, q00235, and q00248 are clipped Ada dialogue or local character voice; other first- and second-person forms occur in speech or maxims. The main residual uncertainty is that quote extraction has removed some dialogue boundaries, but targeted contextual searches resolve the potentially conflicting examples and no credible source indicates first- or second-person base narration.
